title: Round 4 stream C: BELOW loads behind a still game; the start card and the green flare; the fuse hurries; the door belongs to the planet
context: Owner, 2026-11-02, the playtest of b9434246, notes 10-13: (10) 'just before BELOW the fps drops to 17 in the tank view, apparently because BELOW is loading; load behind something static such as Isao's exposition'; (11) 'a callout explaining the controls and the mission (F drops a flare; a GREEN flare pre-dropped close to the entrance/exit; Q for the radar/LiDAR but it's not ready yet)'; (12) 'If Isao is out with a lot of time to spare, the countdown accelerates'; (13) 'The entrance/exit should look like it belongs to the same planet, maybe with the Nih-Dairia carcass outside'. Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-round-4-fifteen-notes-design.md, stream C. Cave changes made in kai-denrei/stalheart-cave (branch round-4-below, not pushed) and re-imported with scripts/import-below.mjs.
outcome: NOTE 10. Measured before deciding (an untracked copy of the suite, headed Chrome, the top window's rAF intervals from ?skip=defence&sector=7's descentNow()): 37 ms a frame before the hand-off; a 1.6 s long task and ~3 s of 100-400 ms frames while the cave built its world; then 57 ms (17.5 fps) STEADY through the rim view and the dive until the frame showed. The same run with the cave's page swapped for about:blank: 25.6 ms. So the spec's reading (the load) was half of it: rAF runs in a display:none same-origin iframe, and the hidden cave drew its whole world for its briefing orbit every frame under the game; the game also drew a full frame per rAF behind the shown, opaque cave. Shipped: the cave (2bbd8f9) posts { belowReady } after its first frame and draws nothing in its frame until the game posts { belowShow }; src/fx/descent-host.js lets the look glide to the rim view on the live game (DESCENT.still 1.8 game s), then c.hold(true) (td-tab: `still` beside `paused`; the paused branch steps only Isao's brief clock and draws nothing, the last frame stays on the canvas; P/Esc ignored under it) and only then makes the frame; when the cave is ready (DESCENT.readyCap 25 real s at most) and the brief read (briefCap, real seconds while still; src/domain/descent.js descentLoadDone) the game runs for the dive; as the frame shows it is held again. After (same probe): the look 24.9 ms, the dive 24.7 ms (40 fps, the no-cave figure), the 1.5 s long task falls under the still frame and the panel, the cave's own briefing 45.7 ms once shown (59.8 before). td-tab net 0 lines. NOTE 11 (both modes, cave 2c08768): a card over the first 8 s, 'MISSION · PLACE THE CHARGE BY THE QUEEN · GET BACK OUT' / 'F · FLARE   GREEN FLARE · THE WAY OUT   Q · LIDAR (NOT READY YET)' (the Q part plain once the LiDAR is processed). The spec's card left out the green flare that the note asks to explain, so it is on the card. A sixteenth flare slot, green, never spent by F, left 1.6 m beside the throat's foot: on the rubble in Stålheart's page, on the throat's rock on the cave's own page. Its light is a quarter of a red flare's because at full strength it flooded the throat green. Isao: 'Fifteen flares. F to drop one. The green one I left here marks the way out.' NOTE 12 (cave 7ecd262): extracted with more than 15 s left, the fuse burns at x4 until 10 s remain, then real time (FUSE_RUSH; out at 80 s: 27.5 s). The spoken countdown is unchanged. Isao: 'I’m out. Bringing the charge forward.' NOTE 13 (?stalheart=1, cave 21a3e3e): the sky disc is the game's night (near-black navy with a sparse star field), raised to 40 m and widened to 90 m. The ring at the mouth is the bowl's rock tone. Nih-Dairia's carcass is the cave's Reed rest pose, still and matte corpse grey (0.12), at twice the hole's diameter across (96 m, as the 40 m mother is to her 20 m hole), flattened to 0.3, resting on the ground's level with its body on the lip and its longest limb across the hole 0.3 rad off the axis: seen up the throat from the start and on the climb, the axis left open, out of the throat and the flares' way. Found in passing: the cave's pause-card RESTART EXPEDITION was never bound (a trailing // comment swallowed it; cave 59d7692), and the cave's browser suites still counted 10 flares and 12/5/4 creatures (stale since 2026-10-18 and 461b716); fixed. Their lamp step followed the 2026-10-16 lamp too (cave 9fd0873); the suite now stops at nursery.tentacles 64 (60 now), left open.
alternatives: Pause the game only during the load (the spec's reading): would leave the hidden cave drawing its orbit every frame during the dive (57 ms measured there) and the game drawing behind the shown cave.

Load the cave as a visibility:hidden frame or detect display:none inside the cave (innerWidth 0, frameElement.hidden): rejected for an explicit { belowReady } / { belowShow } protocol that works with any way of hiding it.
A carcass draped into the bowl or across the throat's mouth: rejected, the climb's camera rises to the mouth on the axis and would pass through it; the body bridges the hole at ground level instead.

The sky as the game's day (tronColors' hemisphere, as round 3 had it): the spec chose the game's night (the stars the game draws its sky on); one knob each (DOOR.sky, skyEdge, stars) if the owner wants it lit.
